types.description: Provisional generic two-terminal pilot light; supply voltage, AC/DC class and polarity must be selected by the author.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: Lamp pair X1/X2; both ends are required for the sole indication load. Optional: none in this interface. Unmodeled: additional colors, test/dimmer connections, drivers and bonding. Author must select hardware and add voltage, AC/DC class, polarity and applicable ratings; none are inferred from X1/X2. No manufacturer pinout is asserted.
